entrance.name: Entrance Hall
entrance.description: You are in a grand entrance hall. A door leads north.

items.name: Crested Key
items.description: A small key with an old monarch's crest engraved in it

items.name: Lantern
items.description: A lantern with its candle barely a-flame

library.name: Library
library.description: Books line the walls. It's quiet... A door leads south. A door lined with silver stands tall westward. Eastward, a long narrow hallway lies.

items.name: Dusty Book
items.description: A book littered with dustballs and cobwebs

chamber.name: Lavish Chambers
chamber.description: Marvelous portraits line the walls, all leading to a pristine throne. This seems to be the abode of great royalty.

items.name: Pile of Gold Coins
items.description: A stack of glimmering gold coins

items.name: Monarch's Crown
items.description: A king's crown, with gold plating and jewels lining the bottom

hallway.name: Hallway
hallway.description: A narrow hallway with a room to the north and west.

cellar.name: Wine Cellar
cellar.description: Barrels of wine line the walls, the sweet aroma of finely aged wine fills the air.
